description: ApiKeyPostResponse.keySecret is the generated API key secret, returned once by POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/keys ('Generated key secret. Provided only if there was no hashData in the request.'), and ApiKeyHashData.keySecretHash is the SHA-256 of a caller-chosen secret sent in its place. Neither carries a sensitive mark (the converter's patterns do not match `keySecret`), so the secret surfaced as a plain string. Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-11).
